product.name: Naqla Trucking Platform
product.description: A digital platform connecting shippers with a network of carriers for domestic and cross-border trucking services, offering real-time tracking and AI-based route optimization.

product.name: Naqla Store
product.description: A service offering truck drivers access to spare parts, tires, and equipment with payment plans to manage overhead costs and maintain their vehicles.

product.name: AI-Powered Route Optimization and Backhauling
product.description: An AI-driven system that optimizes delivery routes and truck utilization by planning efficient round trips and reducing empty return trips (backhauling).

product.name: Real-Time Shipment and Fleet Tracking
product.description: A tracking system providing near real-time visibility of shipments, trucks, warehouses, and financials to enable supply chain monitoring and control.
